2 John 1.summary: The elder writes unto the elect lady and her children, whom he loves in the truth, and not he only but also all they that have known the truth, for the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us and shall be with us for ever (2 John 1:1–2). Grace, mercy, and peace are with them from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love (2 John 1:3). He rejoiced greatly that he found of her children walking in truth, and he beseeches her, not as though he wrote a new commandment, but that which they had from the beginning, that we love one another, and this is love, that we walk after his commandments (2 John 1:4–6). Many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh, and this is a deceiver and an antichrist (2 John 1:7). They are to look to themselves that they lose not those things which they have wrought but receive a full reward, for whosoever transgresseth and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ hath not God, but he that abideth in it hath both the Father and the Son (2 John 1:8–9). If there come any unto them and bring not this doctrine, they are not to receive him into their house, neither bid him God speed, for he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds (2 John 1:10–11). The elder has many things to write but will not with paper and ink, trusting to come unto them and speak face to face, that their joy may be full, and the children of her elect sister greet her (2 John 1:12–13).
2 John 1.whereWeAre: 2 John follows 1 John and is a short letter from the elder to the elect lady and her children. It joins love and truth, warns against deceivers who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh, and tells believers not to receive them into the house (1:1-13). 3 John follows.

keyFigures.name: The elder
keyFigures.role: Writes to the elect lady, rejoices that her children walk in truth, and hopes to speak face to face (1:1,4,12).

keyFigures.name: The elect lady and her children
keyFigures.role: Loved in the truth, told to love one another and walk after his commandments (1:1,5-6).

keyFigures.name: God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ
keyFigures.role: The Father and the Son, from whom grace, mercy, and peace come, and whom he that abideth in the doctrine hath (1:3,9).

keyFigures.name: The deceivers
keyFigures.role: Many entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh (1:7).

keyFigures.name: He that biddeth God speed to such a teacher
keyFigures.role: Becomes partaker of his evil deeds (1:10-11).

keyFigures.name: The children of her elect sister

keyThemes.explanation: The elder loves the elect lady and her children in the truth, and grace, mercy, and peace are with them in truth and love (1:1-3).
This is love, that we walk after his commandments, which is the commandment they had from the beginning (1:4-6).

keyThemes.theme: Guarding the true teaching about Christ
keyThemes.explanation: Many deceivers are entered into the world who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh, so believers are to abide in the doctrine of Christ (1:7-9).
If there come any who bring not this doctrine, they are not to receive him into their house or bid him God speed (1:10-11).

keyThemes.theme: Perseverance and complete joy in fellowship
keyThemes.explanation: The elder hopes to speak face to face, that their joy may be full, and warns them to look to themselves that they receive a full reward (1:8,12-13).
